title: Data Citation for Large Language Models: A Challenge
abstract: arXiv:2608.25663v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models increasingly mediate access to information, and a growing body of work asks whether they cite the sources behind their outputs. That work treats citation as a verification device and applies it to textual documents. Scholarly citation serves two further functions, credit and provenance, and it applies to data as much as to text. This paper argues that data citation for large language models is an open challenge, distinct from document-level citation grounding and harder to solve. We ask how such models should cite data so that outputs stay verifiable, provenance stays traceable, and credit reaches data creators and curators. We set out three research directions. Training data attribution has to turn influence estimates into references for corpora absorbed into model parameters. translated_title: 大型语言模型的数据引用：一个挑战
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25663v1 公告类型：新 摘要：大型语言模型日益成为信息获取的中介，越来越多的研究关注它们是否引用了其输出背后的来源。这些研究将引用视为验证工具，并将其应用于文本文档。学术引用还承担着另外两个功能：归功和溯源，并且它既适用于数据也适用于文本。本文认为，大型语言模型的数据引用是一个开放的挑战，不同于文档级别的引用溯源，且更难解决。我们探讨这些模型应如何引用数据，以使输出保持可验证性、溯源保持可追踪性，并让功劳归于数据创建者和策展者。我们提出了三个研究方向：训练数据归因需将影响力估计转化为对模型参数中吸收的语料库的引用；推理时的数据引用需以正确的粒度和固定性识别数据集、子集和查询结果；引用知识图谱。
tldr: 本文指出大型语言模型的数据引用是一个独特且更难的挑战，并提出了三个研究方向来解决输出验证、溯源和归功问题。
en_tdlr: This paper argues that data citation for large language models is a distinct and harder challenge, proposing three research directions to address output verification, provenance, and credit.
